sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B is a code-specialized large language model with 14.7 billion parameters maintained by Qwen. Built on the foundation of Qwen2.5, it processes up to 131,072 tokens of context (expandable via YaRN rope scaling to handle documents exceeding 32,768 tokens).
